title: Task durable business contract projection
description: Machine-readable validation projection of the accepted Task domain contract (docs/architecture/task-engine.md). Validates representation shape only: status value, baseline fields, provider neutrality. It does not validate lifecycle transitions, READY preconditions, DAG acyclicity, scope authorization, or completion authority.
$comment: Contract projection / validation representation only. Task JSON Schema != Task persistence format (SQLite) and != IPC encoding (Protobuf). Required fields are minimal identity/core (id, objective, status) because DRAFT completeness and READY preconditions remain open design items; schema required rules must not invent them. additionalProperties is intentionally permissive so the schema stays evolution-friendly; unknown fields are neither authorized nor forbidden by this projection — trusted application/domain validation decides. Schema-valid JSON != authorized Task state and != Policy approval. See docs/architecture/task-engine.md for semantics.

id.description: Task identity as non-empty string. Universal ID format (UUID, ULID, integer, pattern) remains open and is not constrained here.

objective.description: Intended work. Representation only; the schema does not judge whether the objective is good enough.

parent.description: Optional parent/epic reference. Absence means no parent reference is supplied in this representation.

depends_on.description: Dependency references. DAG acyclicity and dependency existence are application/domain validation, not schema concerns.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria as durable Task intent. Tests are evidence for criteria, never the criteria themselves.

scope.description: Explicit execution-scope contract. Syntax validity never authorizes a path; Policy approval and Runner enforcement remain with trusted runtime layers. The object stays open to future scope dimensions.

verification.description: Required verification references owned by the Task. No verification taxonomy is established; Evaluation owns execution and interpretation.

required_review.description: Required review references owned by the Task. No closed review taxonomy is established.

risk.description: Optional risk metadata. No universal risk taxonomy (levels, dimensions) is established; architecture-defined metadata is allowed without prescribing it.

artifacts.description: Artifact references. Task references artifacts; it is never the artifact blob store. Reference ID format remains open.

kind.description: Optional extensible routing/planning metadata. kind != provider: provider-specific kinds are forbidden and no closed kind enum exists.

status.description: Canonical lifecycle value exactly as accepted. The schema validates the value only; legal transitions belong to the Task domain/application service.
